# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.102

Security runtime and verified backup coverage update.

- Both compiled executables embed Node 22.23.5, packaged with pinned pkg 6.26.0.
  Installing standalone Node does not update compiled application runtimes.
- Daily PostgreSQL backups and weekly site backups create separate verified
  delivery-recovery ZIP companions containing delivery archives, hidden sequence
  ledger, compressed files/checksum receipts, package metadata and the compiled
  renderer. Every ZIP entry is checksum-verified and sources must remain unchanged.
- Failed dump identity or delivery coverage verification reports backup failure
  and retains previous backups. Retention/manual deletion removes matching
  companions with their dump/site ZIP. High-resolution daily filenames avoid
  ordinary same-second backup collisions.
- General site ZIPs exclude nested backup folders while preserving the existing
  precise PHI delivery-archive exclusion. Keep the separate recovery companion
  and checksum receipt with its main backup.
- No schema migration, patient/RX rewrite, configured RX Action change or proxy,
  firewall, account or security-policy change. Production retention settings and
  the PostgreSQL 18.7 engine patch are separately verified operational changes.
- Project identity page and startup checks help distinguish this workspace from
  other applications. Existing Project Control 2.2.2 guarded update flow is retained.

Build, lifecycle, security and package verification must pass locally for the
exact source commit. Preserve current application/database rollback and private
filesystem recovery. Install through Project Control only. Existing moderate
Sequelize/UUID and unchanged Softphone findings remain documented; this release
does not claim to fix unrelated source findings.
